units.acceptance_policy: Named children gate full family acceptance. Existing deps describe required source foundations; acceptance_children are not folded into deps to avoid misrepresenting recursive semantic acceptance as a source-build cycle. C03 lands only qualified dependency-closed children.

budget.generated_tables_and_captures: Separate commit, hash-addressed and excluded from handwritten review budget
budget.split_rule: Split before the limit. A family record becomes ordered child PRs of at most six classifiers, eight related features, four operations or one initializer/rule behavior cluster; dependencies are explicit, no unordered common-file edits.

commit_plan: 1. Freeze one exact behavior/API family and red regression or matched native capture

done_when: Every named behavior and every discovered native branch in this slice has an expected/observed disposition
Rust results match pinned native outcomes or an explicitly reviewed improvement; unsupported does not count as parity
Actual application caller consumes the new Rust path; no Java/Spring/EMF/AQL/Syside/Langium executable is required in production

C03 lands prerequisites, retargets the PR and reruns affected integration/acceptance checks
